content:
Hi all! My team at Axiomatic AI is hiring for a Research Intern in Formal Methods for Physics. At Axiomatic, we are applying Lean to build verifiable AI systems for science and engineering.

This role is particularly well suited to PhD students interested in pioneering the application of Lean to physics, bridging the gap between formal logic and the physical sciences while leveraging tools that make formal reasoning more scalable and useful in practice. You would collaborate with the team in developing the formal infrastructure capable of supporting scientific applications of formal methods.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a PhD (preferred), or advanced Master’s degree in Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field

  • Strong proficiency in Lean is required (1+ years, contribution to open-source projects)

  • Strong research skills and ability to work on open-ended technical problems

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with researchers and engineers

How to apply: If you are interested, please apply directly here

For more information about Axiomatic, see our talk at Lean Together 2026: Autoformalization for Physics and Engineering with Lean.

Location: on-site at our Barcelona office

Duration: 3-6 months

Our team is also hiring for two more AI focused roles, but still working on formal methods applications:

  • Internship – Research Intern (AI for Scientific Reasoning)

  • AI Research Scientist - Scientific Reasoning

If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to me directly here on Zulip or email me at  austin@axiomatic-ai.com.
